description: Na₂MnGaF₇ crystallizes in the trigonal P3_121 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to seven F atoms to form distorted NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one MnF₆ octahedra, corners with two GaF₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent MnF₆ octahedra, and edges with two GaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-67°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.73 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.71 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.17-2.90 Å. Mn is bonded to six F atoms to form MnF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnF₆ octahedra, corners with four GaF₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramid, and edges with two equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 32-53°. There are a spread of Mn-F bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.15 Å. There are two inequivalent Ga sites. In the first Ga site, Ga is bonded to six F atoms to form GaF₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent MnF₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 32-46°. There are a spread of Ga-F bond distances ranging from 1.90-1.94 Å. In the second Ga site, Ga is bonded to six F atoms to form GaF₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent MnF₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 45°. There are two shorter (1.92 Å) and four longer (1.94 Å) Ga-F bond lengths. There are seven inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Ga atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mn, and one Ga atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one Ga atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Ga atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Ga tetrahedra. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two equivalent Mn atoms. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one Ga atom. In the seventh F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mn, and one Ga atom.
